title: malva occidentalis
intro: Malva occidentalis, commonly known as Western Mallow, is a plant species belonging to the Malvaceae family. It is a perennial herb native to the western coast of North America, and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is known to possess anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating wounds, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Malva occidentalis include mucilages, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its potential health benefits, such as soothing digestive issues and reducing inflammation.
